name: – Evin Incir, Joanna Scheuring-Wielgus – Alternative motion for a resolution – Am 2
title: REPORT on the importance of consent-based rape legislation in the EU
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Commission to propose an EU-wide law defining rape as sex without freely given consent. Consent must be voluntary, informed and can be withdrawn at any time. Silence, freezing or not resisting is not consent. The Parliament also asks member states to change national laws that still require proof of force or resistance, and to improve support and training for victims.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is a non-binding request; no law is adopted.
- **Who it affects:** Rape victims, police, judges and prosecutors in all EU countries.
- **Next step:** The Commission decides whether to propose such a law; member states are urged to act.
